instruction: Could you assist me in placing my photo on the desktop and renaming it to export.jpg?

action:
import pyautogui, time, os
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','shift','e')
time.sleep(1)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','l')
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.write(os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/export.jpg'), interval=0.01)
pyautogui.press('enter')

# The image was exported, but GIMP saved it as export.jpg.jpg; rename it on the Desktop to export.jpg.
import os, time
src = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/export.jpg.jpg")
dst = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/export.jpg")
if os.path.exists(src):
    os.replace(src, dst)
time.sleep(0.5)
